threads.title: A Place to Stand
threads.opening: We have somewhere to land. We still need somewhere to belong.
threads.escalation: The shelf is waiting; decide what you can bring to it.
threads.success: The camp is established. A place to return to is now part of the war.
threads.failure: The company came back with unfinished work. The jungle is still there.
threads.changed: The situation has changed. Reassess the home route before committing again.
threads.callback: You built a place worth returning to.

perspectives.speaker: ketha
perspectives.text: I can mend a company. Give me somewhere to put it.

perspectives.speaker: vane
perspectives.text: A camp is a promise we have to defend.

choices.label: Raid for the home
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction from Greenest Fields. No deadline.
choices.response: Ketha clears a corner of the supply table. "All right. We start here. Try not to build the infirmary downhill from the ammunition."

choices.label: Establish the camp
choices.obligation: Raise the existing home camp, then complete a sortie. No deadline.
choices.response: Ketha clears a corner of the supply table. "All right. We start here. Try not to build the infirmary downhill from the ammunition."

choices.label: A home starts with who comes back.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction with explicit survivor records showing no hero wounds or losses. No deadline.
choices.response: Ketha leaves a space at the table instead of drawing a bigger perimeter. "Good. Start with people. Walls can learn to wait."
choices.success: You promised people before walls, and the field report supports that promise.
choices.callback: Ketha taps the empty chair. "Still a chair. Not a memorial. That was the plan."

threads.title: The Price of Shelter
threads.reason: Owned ground opens routes, but holding it takes work.
threads.opening: Every foothold is a door that opens both ways.
threads.success: A confirmed claim gives the company ground to stand on.
threads.failure: The ground is not secured yet. Check the next operation's requirements.
threads.changed: The commitment has run its course or the foothold is gone. Choose a fresh route; no territory is awarded.
threads.callback: You made holding ground part of the company's story.

perspectives.speaker: warder
perspectives.text: A wall is a place to put your back.

perspectives.speaker: vane
perspectives.text: And a place the enemy knows to find it.

choices.label: Commit to securing ground
choices.obligation: Confirm a node claim within the next three completed sorties.
choices.response: Vane marks the ground. "Then it gets a name, a route, and someone watching the route."

choices.label: Our home travels with us. Keep a way out.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction within three completed sorties. This does not defend or surrender territory.
choices.response: Vane folds the perimeter sketch along the road. "A door that only opens inward is a trap."
choices.success: You backed your preference for mobility with a clean return.
choices.callback: The old perimeter sketch now has an exit drawn on it. Nobody has erased it.

choices.label: Build somewhere worth defending.
choices.obligation: Raise the home camp, then complete a sortie within three completed sorties. An already established camp meets the building condition.
choices.response: Ketha studies the supply list. "Beds first. If you call a gun emplacement a bed again, you sleep in it."
choices.success: Your established camp gives substance to the promise of shelter.
choices.callback: The company measures shelter in places to rest as well as places to fire.

threads.title: What We Bring Back
threads.reason: Extraction turns battlefield gains into a future.
threads.opening: There is always one more valuable thing beyond the line.
threads.escalation: There is still a way home. Decide what is worth carrying.
threads.success: The company completed a clean extraction. The result ledger records what survived.
threads.failure: The return was costly. Read the losses before choosing the next risk.
threads.changed: The extraction commitment has changed. Re-plan with the company you have.
threads.callback: You once chose a route home. The company remembers that.

perspectives.speaker: ketha
perspectives.text: Wrecks can wait. People are harder to rebuild.

perspectives.speaker: brakhov
perspectives.text: There is still heat in that ridge.

choices.label: Make a clean return the priority
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction within three completed sorties.
choices.response: Ketha draws a heavy line beneath extraction. "This bit is part of the mission. I want that understood before we leave."

choices.label: Nobody is spare equipment.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction with explicit survivor records showing no hero wounds or losses within three completed sorties.
choices.response: Ketha closes the salvage tally. "I will still count the metal. I will just count you first."
choices.success: The survivor report backs your promise to put people first.
choices.callback: Someone has written PEOPLE at the top of the salvage board. Ketha declines to identify the handwriting.

choices.label: Take the risk that buys us a future.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction from Greenest Fields within three completed sorties. No minimum loot or optional objective is promised.
choices.response: Brakhov leans toward the map. "Then we go for a reason. Not because something over there is still standing."
choices.success: You made the raid and returned cleanly. The ledger, not the promise, decides its profit.
choices.callback: The raid is now an argument the company can refer to: ambition needs a route home.

threads.title: Friends of Convenience
threads.reason: Null Merc standing affects who fights beside you.
threads.opening: A shared enemy is a beginning, not an oath.
threads.escalation: The mercs will judge the next field result.
threads.success: You completed the promised operation away from the dealer's ground. Existing faction rules determine the standing change.
threads.failure: Shared interests have not yet become a successful operation.
threads.changed: The promised window passed. The next conversation begins with unfinished business.
threads.callback: The mercs have a field result to remember.

perspectives.speaker: vane
perspectives.text: I trust a flank I can see.

perspectives.speaker: vale
perspectives.text: I prefer the terms written down.

choices.label: Promise a successful field operation
choices.obligation: Win an operation outside Eye of Horus within three completed sorties. Existing reputation rules still apply.
choices.response: Vane checks the map again. "A promise with a destination. I can live with that."

choices.label: Cooperate, but promise them nothing.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction within three completed sorties. This promise is to your company; it grants no faction standing.
choices.response: Vane nods. "A shared road. Separate steering wheels."
choices.success: You kept the company moving without pretending a field result was an alliance.
choices.callback: When someone calls the mercs family, the company still asks which part of the contract says that.

choices.label: Our people set the terms.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction with explicit survivor records showing no hero wounds or losses within three completed sorties. No alliance is created.
choices.response: Vale considers the wording. "An actual term. Better than mutual benefit, which usually means their benefit twice."
choices.success: You backed your terms with a clean, unwounded return recorded by the result.
choices.callback: The phrase our people first has made it into the margins of the company agreements.

threads.title: The Dealer’s Grudge
threads.reason: Cortex remembers destruction on its ground.
threads.opening: The dealer remembers what you broke, even when you call it business.
threads.escalation: A return to Horus carries the weight of the last visit.
threads.success: You returned from Horus. The existing battle result determines the dealer's actual response.
threads.failure: The account is still open. A failed operation does not erase a grudge.
threads.changed: The return was deferred. Review current dealer access before another commitment.
threads.callback: Horus is no longer just a point on the map.

perspectives.speaker: vale
perspectives.text: Read the price before you touch the shelf.

choices.label: Commit to returning from Horus
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction from Eye of Horus within three completed sorties. This does not guarantee improved reputation.
choices.response: Brakhov smiles. Vale keeps reading. Neither finds the other reassuring.

choices.label: We can earn our living elsewhere.
choices.obligation: Win an operation outside Eye of Horus within three completed sorties. This does not repair Cortex standing.
choices.response: Vale puts the invoice face down. "A price is only compulsory if we insist on shopping here."
choices.success: You won elsewhere. The company has an answer to the claim that Horus is its only future.
choices.callback: The old invoice is still on the table. It no longer occupies the whole table.

choices.label: Bring everyone home before settling accounts.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction with explicit survivor records showing no hero wounds or losses within three completed sorties. No dealer access is restored.
choices.response: Brakhov looks disappointed. Ketha looks at Brakhov. The disappointment becomes private.
choices.success: You put a documented safe return ahead of the grudge.
choices.callback: The company remembers a debt you chose not to collect with its bodies.

threads.title: The Shape of the Company
threads.reason: Shared deployments leave wounds and relationships.
threads.opening: The same company can want very different futures.
threads.escalation: A quieter return can give those disagreements room to breathe.
threads.success: A clean return kept this commitment alive in the company's memory.
threads.failure: The return did not settle the company's unfinished business.
threads.changed: The company needs a new commitment suited to its current condition.
threads.callback: The company remembers that coming home mattered.

perspectives.speaker: ketha
perspectives.text: We are more than the list of what still fires.

perspectives.speaker: vane
perspectives.text: Then let's keep the list long.

choices.label: Commit to a careful return
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction with explicit survivor records showing no hero wounds or losses within three completed sorties.
choices.response: Ketha nods once. "Careful is work. It means planning for the person who cannot keep up."

choices.label: We are the ones who make a foothold.
choices.obligation: Confirm a node claim within three completed sorties. Territory still follows the existing campaign rules.
choices.response: Vane studies the line. "Then say where. Courage without a location is just noise."
choices.success: A confirmed claim gives your declaration a place on the map.
choices.callback: The company can point to ground when someone asks what your promise meant.

choices.label: We survive by making the next return possible.
choices.obligation: Complete a clean extraction within three completed sorties. Wounds and losses still count under the existing rules.
choices.response: Ketha takes a breath. "I can work with an honest promise. Do not turn it into an excuse."
choices.success: You delivered the clean extraction you promised. The costs remain in the ledger.
choices.callback: When plans grow grand, someone asks the small question you taught them: and how do we get back?
